commit: feat(custom-element): inject child components styles to custom element shadow root

truth.description: createComponentInstance now copies the parent's ce onto every child instance, and renderSlot still reads a set ce as the mark of the custom element's root component, so a regular child component used inside a custom element renders its <slot/> as a native slot element and the content passed to that child never shows.

distractions.why: The only object ever stored in an instance's ce is a VueElement, so the cast back from the narrower interface type reads the real shadowRoot.
